part: 1 of 2: C, D, I and J (R47b, R52, R53, R55, R58); part 2 is SYNTHETIC_ALLOCATION_CASES.json
replaces: the 046e naming examples (cps.naming-examples.draft.v1), superseded for C and D by R52

resources.note: INVENTED placeholders shared by every case and by EXAMPLE_INVENTORY.json. They are not the owner-reviewed company resources, which are private.
resources.context:company_name: 示例機電股份有限公司

job_inputs.context:project_name: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

assumptions: Unless a case says otherwise, the source is the company material list (材料清單, R47b) with the columns listed under resources, the line lies inside the quoted range (R49) of the bill sheet that carries the prices, and every row carries L, M and N from the job inputs (R48) with K, O, P, G and H null.
Input cells are the line's own cells: description (a list when the item has continuation rows), unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, brand, model, remarks. A missing key means an empty cell.

A category chain is a run of delimited segments before the item's own noun that only name a product category: a segment ending in 類, or a word in the glossary's category_words (R52). It is dropped on every line type.

Expected values list only the fields the case is about; "row": false means the line gives no 未填 row and its cells take the stated census role. A row whose C is null has status research_draft with a null reason for C (R57, route v4.1).

input.description: 產品，控制開關類，選擇開關，30mm

cases.reason: Equipment line (switch). The glossary prefix 產品 is dropped with its delimiter, 控制開關類 is the category chain (it ends in 類), and the head noun 選擇開關 has a glossary entry, so C is its abbreviation. D is the rest, verbatim. C derived through the glossary cites the description cell and context:glossary (R58).

input.description: 產品，計時器類，限時繼電器，AC220V

cases.reason: Equipment line (timer relay). The glossary has no entry for 限時繼電器 and the line has no Latin acronym, so C is the head noun: the first segment after the prefix and the category chain 計時器類.

input.description: 產品，電錶類，電壓表96角型，附切換開關

cases.reason: Equipment line (meter). The head-noun segment 電壓表96角型 carries a digit, so C is cut before the first digit. D is the rest after removing the prefix, the category chain and C's leading noun part; 附切換開關 is not a rating token, so the comma stays (R53).

Equipment line (switch) with no category chain, no glossary entry and no Latin acronym. The head-noun segment carries a bracket, so C is cut before it; the bracket and the rest go to D verbatim. (綠) is a colour, not a rating token, so R53 changes nothing here.

description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC110V，

cases.reason: The continuation row is joined to the description with no separator. 電磁開關 is a category word the glossary lists, so it is the category chain; the head noun 電磁接觸器 has the glossary abbreviation XMC. 附端子蓋 is not a rating token, so its comma stays.

input.description: 產品，電線電纜類，600V XLPE電纜，3C，2mm²

cases.reason: Material line (cable and wire): C is null and D is the description without the generic prefix and the category chain 電線電纜類. Only the comma between the two rating tokens 3C and 2mm² becomes a space (R53). Material lines leave I and J null even when priced (R55).
PLC modules and software are material lines under R52: C null, D the description without the prefix and the category chain PLC模組類. CPU模組 is not a rating token, so the comma stays.
A valve written size-first, and any description that starts with a digit, is a material line: C null, D verbatim.
Service, labour and fee line: C null; D is the description without the generic prefix.
A single-segment description goes to D with C null, even when it names equipment, unless the glossary lists the noun. The glossary has no entry for 流量計.
Single-segment description (hardware) without a glossary entry: it goes to D and C is null.
Remarks and code columns never enter C or D, even when they read like a specification; they stay in raw text. 指示燈 is the head noun (no category chain) and has the glossary abbreviation XPL.
Rating tokens: each comma between two rating-like tokens becomes one space and the wrapping brackets around them are dropped.

input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，(AC，220V)，附輔助接點

cases.reason: R53 applies on every line type, not only breakers: the bracketed rating tokens AC and 220V are joined by a space without their brackets. 附輔助接點 is not a rating token, so the comma before it stays.

input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: Priced equipment line whose brand and model cells are empty: the brand table entry for the device type and rating band applies (the table is the fallback when neither source states a brand or model). The fields cite the description cell and context:brand_table (R58).
A brand or model stated in the line's own cells (the material list's 廠牌 and 型號 columns) is copied and takes precedence over the brand table. The single-segment description goes to D (R52).

expected.null_reason_I_J: the brand table covers 無熔絲開關 only up to 100AT; the line's brand and model cells are empty

cases.reason: A rating the table does not cover leaves I and J null with a reason. The glossary abbreviation still applies to C.

The glossary has no entry for 自動切換開關, and the source writes the Latin acronym in brackets after the noun, so C is the acronym alone. D is the rest after removing C's segment, with the rating tokens joined by a space (R53).
A Latin acronym fused to the noun also gives C = the acronym alone.

input.description: 產品，控制開關類，選擇開關，φ30mm，2a2b

cases.reason: R53 on a switch line: the comma between the size φ30mm and the contact rating 2a2b becomes one space.
The material list states the brand and model, so they are copied; the brand table (which would give 示例乙牌 / XB-100 for this rating) is not used.
A single-segment description whose noun the glossary lists: C is the abbreviation and D is null.

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet)
input.remarks: 廠牌：示例儀器 型號：FM-100

cases.reason: Without a material list the contract is the source. A brand or model stated in the line's own cells, here its remark, is copied and takes precedence over the brand table. The remark supplies I and J but never enters D.
